title: Test plan sheet
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Variables in games and e-bullying
source: Seeded from computing/y6 lesson 8 (Test plan sheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 8: A timer and game over; debugging the game. To understand how a timer variable and selection end a game

questions.q: Add the countdown timer to the Stage.
questions.a: set time to 30; repeat until time = 0 (wait 1, change time by -1); broadcast game over.
questions.model: Teacher builds it and watches the monitor count down.

questions.q: Add 'when I receive game over: show, stop all' to a text sprite.
questions.a: The game shows 'Game over' and stops.

questions.q: Core: Add game over for lives = 0 too, then run the 3-row test plan and fill it in.
questions.a: if lives = 0 then broadcast game over; test plan completed.
questions.model: Teacher completes row 1 of the test plan live.

questions.q: Extend: Swap projects with the class studio and test a partner's game. Write one kind, specific comment.
questions.a: For example: 'The timer works well; the apple could start in more places.'

questions.q: Stretch: Show the final score on the game over screen.
Which block stops the timer at 0? A) forever B) repeat until time = 0 C) wait 1
Big question: what decides when your game is over?
questions.a: Selection on variables: when time or lives reaches 0, the game broadcasts game over.
